name: Bell Pepper Nachos
desc: Bell pepper pieces used as chips, topped with taco-seasoned beef, black beans, corn and cheese and baked until melty.

source.title: Bell Pepper Nachos
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 lb lean ground beef or ground turkey
ingredients.item: lean ground beef or ground turkey

ingredients.raw: 3/4 cup canned black beans, drained and rinsed
3/4 cup corn kernels (frozen and thawed, or canned and drained)
ingredients.note: frozen and thawed, or canned and drained

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and line 2 sheet pans with parchment.
Core and seed the peppers and cut each into 6 wedge-shaped "chips". Lay them cut side up on the pans.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the meat and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink (160°F), 8 to 10 min. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer until the liquid mostly coats the meat, about 2 min. Stir in the black beans, corn and jalapeño and cook until heated through.
Spoon the filling onto the pepper chips and top with the cheese.
Bake until the cheese is melted and the peppers are warmed through, about 10 min. Top with guacamole or cilantro if you like and serve warm.
tips: Low-carb appetizer. Top with guac or a cilantro avocado yogurt dressing.

references.title: Healthy Bell Pepper Nachos
references.usedFor: oil and water with the taco seasoning, browning time, bake time until cheese melts
